name: script-forge
description: Script Forge rulebook as a plugin: the anvil skill builds tooling scripts per the rulebook; scaffold, doctor, and lint commands manage every Script Forge workspace.

defaultNamespace.title: Default script namespace
defaultNamespace.description: package.json alias namespace anvil uses when registering scripts, e.g. tools (tools:myScript).

scaffoldDirectory.title: Scaffold directory
scaffoldDirectory.description: Absolute path where scaffold creates new workspaces. Empty = the current working directory.

scriptsDirectory.title: Scripts directory
scriptsDirectory.description: Workspace-relative directory where proper scripts live.

localDirectory.title: Local (scratch) directory
localDirectory.description: Workspace-relative scratch-space root; children tmp/ and raw_data/.

esLintConfigLocation.title: ESLint config location
esLintConfigLocation.description: Absolute path to a custom ESLint flat config, forward slashes. Empty = the project-local eslint.tooling.js copied by scaffold.
